title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 115
description: Ten questions on Psalms 115: glory to Yahweh's name, lifeless idols of silver and gold, and the call to Israel and the house of Aaron to trust in Yahweh.

questions.text: To what does the psalmist ask Yahweh to give glory?
questions.explanation: Psalms 115:1 says: not to us, Yahweh, not to us, but to your name give glory.

questions.text: What question might the nations ask?
questions.explanation: Psalms 115:2 asks: why should the nations say, "Where is their God, now?"

questions.text: Where does the psalmist say our God is?
questions.explanation: Psalms 115:3 says: our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.

answers.text: In the temples of the nations
In the depths of the sea

questions.text: What are the idols of the nations made of?
questions.explanation: Psalms 115:4 says their idols are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

questions.text: The idols have feet, but what can they not do with them?
questions.explanation: Psalms 115:7 says they have feet, but they don't walk.

questions.text: What will happen to those who make the idols?
questions.explanation: Psalms 115:8 says those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.

questions.text: What is Yahweh called, again and again, for those who trust in him?
questions.explanation: Psalms 115:9-11 tells Israel, the house of Aaron and those who fear Yahweh to trust in him, saying each time: he is their help and their shield.

questions.text: Whom will Yahweh bless along with the houses of Israel and Aaron?
questions.explanation: Psalms 115:13 says he will bless those who fear Yahweh, both small and great.

answers.text: Only the priests who serve him
Only the old men of the city
Only the rich and the powerful
Those who fear him, both small and great

questions.text: What has Yahweh given to the children of men?
questions.explanation: Psalms 115:16 says the heavens are Yahweh's heavens, but he has given the earth to the children of men.

questions.text: Who do not praise Yah, according to verse 17?
questions.explanation: Psalms 115:17 says the dead don't praise Yah, neither any who go down into silence.
